# Conformance feature map

<!-- Generated by renderFeatureMap() in src/featureMap.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->
<!-- Regenerate: pnpm --filter @pixi/react exec vitest run test/unit/featureMap -u -->

Every public feature of the baseline facade and the scenarios that cover it. The last column is the outcome against the baseline binding, **@pixi/react facade (React 19.3, Pixi 8)**.

- **contract** scenarios state behaviour every binding must show.
- **parity** scenarios record current upstream behaviour that decision D4 keeps in the facade. They run only for bindings that provide `parity.upstream`.
- An **expected failure** is a confirmed defect of that binding. It is run, must keep failing with the recorded error, and names the issue that owns the fix.

## Intrinsic scene elements: mount, update, reorder, removal

Feature `elements`.

| Scenario | Kind | Expected outcome | Baseline |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `elements.mount` | contract | Each element constructs one node of its kind; the scene tree mirrors the JSX tree. | pass |
| `elements.update` | contract | Changed props are applied to the same node; no node is constructed or destroyed. | pass |
| `elements.reorder` | contract | Scene order follows the new key order; every node keeps its identity and is not destroyed. | pass |
| `elements.insert` | contract | The new node is constructed once and placed at its JSX position. | pass |
| `elements.remove` | contract | The removed node is detached and destroyed exactly once; its siblings are untouched. | pass |
| `elements.type-change` | contract | The old node is destroyed once; a node of the new kind takes its place. | pass |
| `elements.top-level-fragment` | contract | Application children are the scene root's own children: a top-level unkeyed fragment around them keeps every keyed node, as React keeps DOM children of a host root. | pass |

## `<Application>` initialization: success, failure, unmount before init

Feature `Application.init`.

| Scenario | Kind | Expected outcome | Baseline |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Application.init.success` | contract | One initialization; `onInit` receives the initialized app; `useApplication` reports it initialised. | pass |
| `Application.init.children-after-init` | contract | No scene node is constructed before initialization has settled and `onInit` has run. | pass |
| `Application.init.failure-no-unhandled-rejection` | contract | When the scene initialization rejects, no unhandled promise rejection escapes the Application. | pass |
| `Application.init.failure-no-children` | contract | After an initialization failure no child node is constructed. | pass |
| `Application.init.failure-unmount` | contract | Unmounting a failed Application leaves no root behind and raises no error. | pass |
| `Application.init.failure-isolated` | contract | After a failed Application unmounts, a new Application initializes and mounts without any error. | pass |
| `Application.init.unmount-before-init.destroys-app` | contract | Once the pending initialization settles the app is destroyed exactly once and its root is released. | pass |
| `Application.init.unmount-before-init.no-late-commit` | contract | No child is constructed after unmount, or every late node is destroyed before settling ends. | pass |
| `Application.init.unmount-before-init.no-oninit` | contract | `onInit` is never called for an Application that unmounted before initialization settled. | pass |
